players.product: multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCCs), including high-capacity series

quarterly_data.signal: Board secretary Wu Xiaochun (2025 annual results briefing): the company has launched an automotive-grade MLCC series covering 0201 to 2220 sizes with capacitance from 0.1pF to 47μF, now gradually being applied in new-energy-vehicle power systems, motor drives and infotainment systems; MLCC prices move with market supply and demand and are set considering market conditions and production cost.

players.product: ceramic ferrules and sleeves for optical connectors and devices

quarterly_data.signal: Board secretary Wu Xiaochun (2025 annual results briefing): the company is actively developing ceramic package housings for optical communication in the relevant specifications; it has a long-term relationship with an overseas fuel-cell leader and is its main supplier of fuel-cell (SOFC) separator plates. She said rising overseas cloud capex and model iteration are speeding AI computing-infrastructure construction and lifting demand for related communication devices; its products serve communications, AI and data centers, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, semiconductor manufacturing and packaging, new energy and industrial control.
